invariants.statement: The envelope is native user-namespace isolation with no hypervisor in the hot path.
invariants.predicate: Live probe reports a namespaced process and the selected executor is bwrap.

invariants.statement: The host kernel remains shared and is never presented as a second durable state plane.
invariants.predicate: The architecture spec records shared-kernel limits and state remains on the durable plane.

invariants.statement: Each envelope has a private root, private process namespace, and private temporary filesystem.
invariants.predicate: The live probe observes a private PID and tmpfs root with no host home residual.

invariants.statement: Envelope setup cost is measured separately from workload runtime latency.
invariants.predicate: The committed latency receipts report setup and runtime medians independently.

invariants.statement: The /nix surface is read-only and explicitly selected from the host or portable closure.
invariants.predicate: The engine constructs an explicit ro-bind at /nix and accepts --store.

invariants.statement: No durable path is implicitly mounted from host /run.
invariants.predicate: The engine has no /run bind and the tier guard rejects durable /run targets.

invariants.statement: Volatile state is disposable and reproducible.
invariants.predicate: Volatile paths are tmpfs or explicitly marked reproducible scratch output.

invariants.statement: Known home-owned residuals are reported and never silently promoted to authority.
invariants.predicate: The home-owner guard distinguishes known residuals from new regressions.

invariants.statement: Portable release bytes remain usable after relocation of the bundle prefix.
invariants.predicate: The moved-prefix launcher executes with the host store hidden.

invariants.statement: PostgreSQL/RuVector remains the durable macro-state authority.
invariants.predicate: Durable state paths and release receipts identify PostgreSQL/RuVector as canonical.

invariants.statement: GPU access is acquired only when explicitly requested.
invariants.predicate: A probe with --gpu sees device nodes and a probe without it does not.

invariants.statement: Network isolation is explicit and reversible per envelope.
invariants.predicate: Shared networking reports host interfaces while --isolate-net reports loopback only.

invariants.statement: A requested device is passed through without ambient device exposure.
invariants.predicate: The device live test sees the requested node and not unrelated nodes.

invariants.statement: Multiple envelopes share only caller-declared durable roots.
invariants.predicate: Concurrent envelopes have isolated private tmpfs and exactly one line per shared writer.

invariants.statement: meta/var is never mounted into container overlay or volume surfaces.
invariants.predicate: The live container mount guard reports zero violations and rejects fixture violations.

invariants.statement: A host reboot can end processes but cannot destroy durable LifeOS state.
invariants.predicate: The architecture separates process loss from durable state and re-attach.

invariants.statement: The portable release does not claim stronger store independence than its evidence proves.
invariants.predicate: The receipt records remaining host dependencies and blocks stronger claims.
